PreToolUse.command: FILE=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty') && echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '\.(env|pem|key)$|secrets' && { echo '禁止修改敏感文件' >&2; exit 2; } || exit 0
CMD=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty') && echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'rm\s+-rf|sudo|chmod\s+777' && { echo '危险命令已被阻止' >&2; exit 2; } || exit 0

PostToolUse.command: FILE=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty') && [ -n "$FILE" ] && npx prettier --write "$FILE" 2>/dev/null && git add "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || true

Stop.command: CHANGED=$(git diff --name-only HEAD 2>/dev/null | grep -cE '\.(ts|js|py)$') && [ "$CHANGED" -gt 0 ] && npm test 2>&1 | tail -20 || true
